tagline: A&K's new all-suite Nile riverboat, with private openings of Tutankhamun's tomb built in.
answer: Nile Seray is Abercrombie & Kent's newest A&K Sanctuary riverboat, launching in November 2026. She sails four nights between Luxor and Aswan in either direction, with 32 suites for 64 guests, a pool deck, spa and gym. Every sailing includes private openings of Tutankhamun's and Amenhotep III's tombs. Children aged 6 and over sail. She suits travellers who want space and inside access.
facts: Luxor to Aswan or Aswan to Luxor, 4 nights
overview: Nile Seray, an A&K Sanctuary, is the fifth A&K Sanctuary riverboat in Egypt and the most spacious. She launches in November 2026 and sails four nights between Luxor and Aswan, in either direction. Seray means palace.

All 32 suites have floor-to-ceiling windows and a Juliet balcony. Signature Suites start at 33 sq m; the two Royal Suites have a full balcony with a private jacuzzi. Interiors use wood, rattan, local marble and quartzite, with handcrafted furniture and mashrabiya details.

On board are indoor and outdoor restaurants, a top deck pool with cabanas and an outdoor bar, an indoor lounge, a spa with two treatment rooms, a Technogym gym open 24 hours, an elevator and a resident doctor. Ashore, every sailing includes the tombs of Seti I and Ramses VI and private openings of the tombs of Tutankhamun and Amenhotep III.
why: The tomb access is the reason. Seti I and Ramses VI are included, and Tutankhamun and Amenhotep III are opened privately for A&K guests after hours. A&K notes these tombs are not on the usual sightseeing route.

The entry suite is 33 sq m with a Juliet balcony, about twice the size of a Standard Cabin on Nile Adventurer, and the boat carries 64 guests with a staff-to-guest ratio of 1.5 to 1. She is new, so book early for her first winter.

days.title: A welcome in Aswan
days.summary: Board at a private dock to a Zaffa musical procession. After lunch, a felucca sail around Elephantine Island, then Lord Kitchener's Botanical Gardens and the Aga Khan Mausoleum.

days.title: Philae and Kom Ombo
days.summary: Morning motorboat to Agilika Island for the Philae temples and the Granite Quarries. Cruise to Kom Ombo for an evening visit to the Temple of Kom Ombo.

days.title: Edfu, then Luxor
days.summary: Morning visit to the Temple of Edfu, then sail to Luxor with an optional cooking class. Tour the Temple of Luxor and finish with an Egyptian Night on board.

days.title: Karnak and the Valley of the Kings
days.summary: Morning at the Temple of Karnak. Afternoon in the Valley of the Kings with insider access to the tombs of Seti I, Ramses VI and Amenhotep III, then Tutankhamun's tomb at a private opening after the West Bank closes, and a gala dinner.

days.title: Disembark in Luxor
days.summary: Early breakfast and check out at 8am.

days.title: A welcome in Luxor and the West Bank
days.summary: Board at a private dock, then the West Bank: the tombs of Amenhotep III, Seti I and Ramses VI, the Valley of the Queens and the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut. Early evening, Tutankhamun's tomb at a private opening.

days.title: The East Bank, then Esna
days.summary: Morning at the Temple of Luxor and the Temple of Karnak with your Egyptologist. Lunch on board as the boat cruises to Esna.

days.title: Edfu and Kom Ombo
days.summary: Morning visit to the Temple of Edfu, then sail to Kom Ombo with an optional cooking class. Early evening at the Temple of Kom Ombo and an Egyptian Night on board.

days.title: Philae and a felucca in Aswan
days.summary: Motorboat to Agilika Island for the Philae temples and the Granite Quarries. After lunch, a felucca sail around Elephantine Island, then a farewell gala dinner and dervish show.

days.title: Disembark in Aswan
days.summary: Early breakfast and check out at 8am.

pricesNote: Per person, cruise only, USD, two sharing, as published by A&K on 1 Nov 2026. A&K prices by season band, not by sailing date, and the same rate applies in either direction; each departure entry is a band (date to dateTo). Signature Suite rates rise by deck: Main, Mid, Upper. Festive supplements apply 23 to 31 December and Easter (25 to 28 March 2027); an Eclipse Season premium applies 29 July to 5 August 2027. Single rates run about 1.5 times the sharing rate; a child rate is published for every suite type. Included: all meals, afternoon tea, water, tea and coffee at meals, guided excursions with transport, entrance fees and port charges, entry to the tombs of Seti I and Ramses VI, and private openings of the tombs of Tutankhamun and Amenhotep III. Not included: drinks other than water, tea and coffee at meals; international and domestic flights and transfers; travel insurance, laundry, boutique purchases, spa treatments, gratuities and personal items; optional extras such as a hot-air balloon flight, a Nubian village visit or the Aswan spice market. A&K also sells Nile Seray inside longer packages: 'A Holiday Season Cruise on Nile Seray', a 10-day small-group journey departing 20 December 2026, from US$17,495 per person (https://www.abercrombiekent.com/journeys/small-group-journeys/a-holiday-season-cruise-on-nile-seray), and 'Egypt and the Nile: A Private Journey', 10 days with Cairo and Abu Simbel, from US$12,495 per person in 2027 (https://www.abercrombiekent.com/journeys/private-ready-to-book/egypt-and-the-nile-a-private-journey-on-nile-seray). A&K honeymoon offer: 50% off one partner's stay, travel by 31 Dec 2027 and within 6 months of the marriage certificate, not combinable with other offers, can be withdrawn at any time (https://www.abercrombiekent.com/offers/save-on-your-honeymoon-in-egypt-with-a&k-sanctuary).

faqs: When does Nile Seray start sailing?
A&K lists November 2026 as her launch, with rates published from 1 November 2026. She is the fifth A&K Sanctuary riverboat in Egypt.
How much does a Nile Seray cruise cost?

A&K publishes cruise-only rates per person, two sharing. In 2027 a Signature Suite runs from US$3,125 in June to August to US$6,077 in February, March, October and November; a Royal Suite runs US$8,325 to US$12,277. Christmas and Easter cost more, and the eclipse week of 29 July to 5 August 2027 is priced at US$9,750 to US$18,950.
What is included on a Nile Seray cruise?

All meals, afternoon tea, water, tea and coffee at meals, and guided excursions with transport and entrance fees. That includes the tombs of Seti I and Ramses VI and private openings of the tombs of Tutankhamun and Amenhotep III. Other drinks, flights and transfers, spa treatments and gratuities are extra.
What are the suites like on Nile Seray?

All 32 are suites with floor-to-ceiling windows, a Juliet balcony and a king-size bed that converts to twins. Signature Suites are 33 sq m with a walk-in shower; Prestige (49 sq m) and Presidential (53 sq m) add a bathtub; the two Royal Suites (66 sq m) have a full balcony with a private jacuzzi.
What is the difference between Luxor to Aswan and Aswan to Luxor?

The sites are the same. Luxor to Aswan opens with the West Bank tombs and Tutankhamun's private opening on day one and ends with Philae and a felucca. Aswan to Luxor saves the tombs and Karnak for the last full day. Pick the one that fits your flights.
Can children sail on Nile Seray?
Yes, from age 6. Children aged 15 and under share a cabin with at least one adult, and there is a children's menu.
How do you get to Nile Seray?
Fly from Cairo to Luxor (about one hour) or Aswan (about 1 hour 30 minutes), then take a private transfer of about 30 or 45 minutes to the private dock.
Is there a honeymoon offer on Nile Seray?

Yes. A&K gives newlyweds 50% off one partner's stay on its Nile riverboats, including Nile Seray, for travel by 31 December 2027 and within six months of the wedding. It cannot be combined with other offers.
